editorial.thesis: A banking-and-motor-trade city of about 951,000. Its retail is heavy on banks & atms, and thin on fitness & wellness and pharmacy & health retail — and 47% of residents live in zones with under 60% of the city's average retail depth.
takeaways: Branded retail is about 40% of Patna's. 4.62 chain outlets per lakh residents against 11.58 in Patna; 20 of the 51 national brands we track are present, led by Domino's 6, Raymond 5, Reliance Smart / Fresh 3.

The mapped economy leans to banks & finance. Shares of all mapped places: banks & finance 8.6% (Patna 6.4%); automotive 3.7% (Patna 2.9%); services & crafts 4.4% (Patna 6.9%); offices 6.1% (Patna 8.8%). Raw counts would mislead because Patna is mapped more completely (22,868 places against 2,662), so we compare mix, not counts.
Supply and demand are misaligned. 3 zones hold 47% of residents with under 60% of the city's average retail depth. Buniyad Ganj alone has about 230,000 residents and 13 mapped food & drink places.

Retail is more concentrated than in Patna. 52% of commercial places sit in the busiest tenth of the city (Patna 49%). The largest cores are Apcolony · Chand Chourah (1,027 places) and Buniyad Ganj (162).

The widest brand gaps against Patna. Domino's 6 outlets vs 48; Raymond 5 outlets vs 36; Bata 3 outlets vs 33. These are leads to check against live listings, not verdicts: a brand may trade under another name or have opened since the map was updated.

numbers.title: The city in eight numbers
numbers.deck: A 8 km circle around the centre, processed with the same rules as Patna, so every comparison is like for like. Where raw counts would mislead — because a bigger city is mapped more completely — we compare shares and mix instead.

map.title: Where people live, where shops are
map.deck: Switch layers. The amber “gap” layer is the one to study: it marks places with many residents but little retail around them. Hover any hexagon (about 0.1 km²) for its numbers; click a zone on the right to isolate it.

captions.residents: Where people live. Apcolony · Chand Chourah and Buniyad Ganj are the largest zones by residents (456,000 and 230,000). Modelled residents per square kilometre.
captions.supply: Where the shops are. The busiest tenth of cells hold 52% of all commercial places, and Apcolony · Chand Chourah alone lists 1,027.
captions.chains: Where the brands are. Apcolony · Chand Chourah holds 36 of the 44 tracked chain outlets, and Buniyad Ganj adds 5.
captions.education: Where the campuses are. Apcolony · Chand Chourah and Buniyad Ganj lead on education places (183 and 69, with 60 and 12 coaching centres) — a daytime youth market that residents alone do not show.
captions.gap: The gap. Amber: many residents nearby, little retail. Blue: far more retail than local residents explain — the commercial cores that draw people in. The deepest amber sits in Buniyad Ganj and Delha · Kharkhura. The blue cores include Apcolony · Chand Chourah.

zones.title: Zone by zone, by PIN code
zones.deck: Each zone is a postal-code area. Residents are modelled counts; places are mapped businesses and services. “Retail depth” is places per 10,000 residents — the tick marks the city average. Click a row to see it on the map.

mix.title: What the retail layer is made of
mix.deck: Raw counts per resident would favour whichever city is mapped more completely (22,868 places in Patna against 2,662 here). So this compares each category's share of all mapped places. 100 means the same share as Patna; below 100 is thinner, above is stronger.
mix.note: Against Patna, Gaya's mapped places over-index on banks & finance (8.6% vs 6.4%), automotive (3.7% vs 2.9%), shops & retail (15.7% vs 14.3%) and under-index on services & crafts (4.4% vs 6.9%), offices (6.1% vs 8.8%), leisure & entertainment (2.6% vs 3.4%).

chains.title: Who is mapped here, and who is not
chains.deck: 44 outlets of 20 tracked national brands within 8 km — 4.62 per lakh residents against Patna's 11.58 (342 outlets of 33 brands). Filled names have at least one mapped outlet (count shown); dashed names have none.
chains.note: Read dashed names as leads, not verdicts. “No mapped outlet” can mean a brand trades under a different listed name, or has opened since the map was updated. The widest gaps against Patna are Domino's (6 vs 48); Raymond (5 vs 36); Bata (3 vs 33). Premium reports check every lead against live listings.

formats.title: Which formats have room
formats.deck: 9 formats, thinnest first. The index is the format's share of all mapped places relative to Patna's, so low means thin by Patna's standard. “Where to look” ranks zones with at least 40,000 residents by residents per mapped outlet — a first-pass screen for where one more outlet would face the least local competition.

people.title: Who the customers are
people.deck: Age mix inside the 8 km circle, from Meta's age rasters (modelled, not a census).
people.note: Gaya's age mix against Patna: children (0–14) 35.1% vs 31.5%, 15–24 17.8% vs 18.2%, working age 40.1% vs 42.5%, 60+ 7.0% vs 7.8%. Under-25s are 53% of residents.

zones.823001: Reasonably supplied: 1,027 places for about 456,000 residents (index 124), 36 chain outlets.
zones.823003: An under-served zone: about 230,000 residents, 162 mapped places, 13 food & drink and 5 chain outlets. Depth index 39.
zones.823002: An under-served zone: about 145,000 residents, 108 mapped places, 9 food & drink and 0 chain outlets. Depth index 41.
zones.823004: An under-served zone: about 32,000 residents, 29 mapped places, 2 food & drink and 0 chain outlets. Depth index 51.

restaurants.read: Restaurants & fast food are 4.3% of mapped places against 4.3% in Patna, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Domino's 6 (Patna 48), KFC 2 (Patna 17), Pizza Hut 1 (Patna 13), Haldiram's 1 (Patna 4). No mapped outlet in either city: Faasos.
restaurants.watch: Independent eateries are numerous and unevenly mapped. Treat the index as a screen and confirm competitor density street by street.

cafes.read: Cafés, tea & coffee are 1.3% of mapped places against 1.8% in Patna — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Chai Sutta Bar 1 (Patna 3). No mapped outlet in either city: Chaayos, Chai Point, Blue Tokai, Third Wave Coffee.
cafes.watch: Chai stalls and independent cafés are under-mapped. A café concept here competes on price and habit as much as on novelty.

desserts.read: Desserts, sweets & ice cream are 0.6% of mapped places against 0.7% in Patna, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Baskin Robbins 2 (Patna 9). No mapped outlet in either city: Havmor, Naturals, Theobroma, Cream Stone.
desserts.watch: Traditional sweet shops are the real benchmark and sit outside most chain lists.

grocery.read: Grocery & daily needs are 1.7% of mapped places against 2.0% in Patna — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Smart / Fresh 3 (Patna 8), Big Bazaar 2 (Patna 5), Vishal Mega Mart 1 (Patna 4). No mapped outlet in either city: More, Spencer's, Easyday, Star Bazaar.
grocery.watch: Neighbourhood kirana stores are the real incumbents and the least completely mapped outlets, so any gap is overstated. Test a site against local store density before acting.

pharmacy.read: Pharmacy & health retail are 1.3% of mapped places against 2.2% in Patna — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Apollo Pharmacy 1 (Patna 14). No mapped outlet in either city: MedPlus, Wellness Forever, Frank Ross.
pharmacy.watch: Independent chemists are dense and lightly mapped. Hospital and clinic clusters are the natural anchors.

apparel.read: Apparel, footwear & jewellery are 5.3% of mapped places against 5.5% in Patna, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Raymond 5 (Patna 36), V-Mart 3 (Patna 17), Bata 3 (Patna 33), Reliance Trends 2 (Patna 26). No mapped outlet in either city: Max Fashion.
apparel.watch: Established multi-brand traders and local bazaars sit behind these numbers; new entrants compete with them as well as with chains.

banking.read: Banks & ATMs are 8.6% of mapped places against 6.4% in Patna — above its share.
banking.watch: This category includes insurance and agency offices, so it overstates branch banking. Use it as a signal of commercial activity, not a branch count.

coaching.read: Coaching & training are 4.3% of mapped places against 5.3% in Patna — below its share.
coaching.watch: Coaching demand follows the exam calendar. Formats that depend on it should be tested across the academic year.

fitness.read: Fitness & wellness are 2.2% of mapped places against 4.0% in Patna — below its share.
fitness.watch: Gym listings change often and are inconsistently categorised; verify before drawing conclusions.
